attributes.action: if the temperature is above 30°C and theres barely aircon, schools need to close
attributes.background: If the temperature is 30°C or over and less than 50% of the school/workplace has air conditioning, then schools/workplace should be closed until the temperature has cooled down.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
